surfaces.title: Foundations
surfaces.intro: Near-black is the environment. Off-white carries hierarchy. Alpha hairlines create structure. Interaction (hover, pressed) is a neutral white layer; green is reserved for action, selection, progress, and health.

components.title: Canvas
components.note: Root window, page, and PWA chrome use the canvas token.
components.html: Quiet operational canvas.

components.title: Color roles
components.note: Never introduce a raw product color when a semantic role exists.

components.title: Typography
components.note: Applications use platform sans-serif at these roles. Authored web uses Inter.
components.html:

surfaces.title: Primitives
surfaces.intro: Shared controls compiled to web CSS, React Native style objects, and Avalonia styles. The HTML here is the structure Desktop infers.

components.note: Primary fill is the only bright green action. Danger is red, never green.

components.note: Checked uses the action colour, because ticking a box is an action. Do not outline idle boxes in accent green.

components.title: Cards
components.note: Idle cards use a raised surface and a neutral border. Selected tints the fill; do not outline cards in accent green.

components.note: A tappable card is a button, not a card wrapped in a platform button. The generated Button style owns radius, fill, hover, and disabled opacity so Avalonia cannot paint a square around the row.

components.note: Inside the work log, thoughts are a quieter indented disclosure: collapsed they show only Thought, expanded they reveal muted italic body. Thinking is the live label, not the expanded label. Do not put thoughts in au-card.

components.title: Tabs
components.note: Selected tabs use primary text and a 2px accent underline, never a green fill.

components.title: Pane
components.note: A working region inset on the canvas. Use this instead of full-bleed panels butted together at 1px lines, which is what makes a window read as a grid of rectangles.

components.title: Overlay panel
components.note: Dialogs, menus, and popovers sit on the overlay surface with the overlay shadow, above a scrim. A dialog that shares the raised surface with the page behind it does not read as in front of anything.
